headline: 13 Michigan deals, $15.5M raised — led by Solyco Portfolio SPV 3 Omega LLC

top_deals.summary: Solyco Portfolio SPV 3 Omega LLC, a Rochester-based private equity fund, disclosed a $100M raise; $0 sold.
Solyco Portfolio SPV 3 LLC, a Rochester-based private equity fund, disclosed a $50M raise; $0 sold.
Grounded Rvs Inc., a Detroit-based technology company, filed a $4.8M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $4.7M sold to 29 investors.
Capitan Orthopedics, Inc., a Grand Rapids-based health care company, filed a $4.1M debt and security to be acquired offering under Rule 506(b); $4.1M sold to 38 investors. (Amended filing.)
KBH Partners, LLC, a Caledonia-based manufacturing company, filed a $3M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $2.2M sold to 18 investors. (Amended filing.)

notable_ma.summary: Motive GM Holdings II LLC and others reported a 65.4% stake in Workhorse Group Inc. (WKHS) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 1).

material_agreements.summary: Credit Acceptance Corp (CACC) entered into a material definitive agreement.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $15.5M sold across 11 Form D filings this week, down 96% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Grounded Rvs Inc. (Detroit, Other Technology) targeting $4.8M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

4 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $1.6M raised so far — led by Solyco Portfolio SPV 3 Omega LLC (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?

Motive GM Holdings II LLC and others reported a 65.4% stake in Workhorse Group Inc. (WKHS) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 1). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
